title: DCP Overlapping CNOT DAG Carry Fanout Obstruction
claims: Overlapping CNOT DAG compression x(u; x_0) = x_0 xor V u introduces multilinear carry cross-terms (-2)^{|J|-1} prod_{j in J} u_j on shared rows |S_r| >= 2.
Cross-terms vanish for all (x_0, u) mod 2^t iff 4*A_{.,r} == 0 on each shared row AND 2*sum_{r:j,k in S_r} A_{.,r} == 0 on every wire pair, all modulo 2^t.
The old termwise 2*A == 0 condition is sufficient but not necessary; duplicate shared rows can cancel even for full-column-rank V.
